name: PyPI JSON API
rate_limits: No published rate limits. All responses are CDN-cached. Reasonable use expected.
notes: Official Python Package Index API. No auth required. Key endpoints: GET /pypi/<project>/json for latest version metadata, GET /pypi/<project>/<version>/json for specific version. Returns info (author, description, classifiers), releases, download URLs, and vulnerability data from the OSV project. PyPI Stats API at pypistats.org/api provides aggregate download statistics. Essential for Python ecosystem analysis, security auditing, and dependency research.
